control: 'Hubs' link of the admin top bar (GET /admin/hubs); also reached after every save or archive
inputs_validation: none to type; admin role only (other roles get 403); includeArchived is true unless the query says 0 or false; load counts orders still to cook (BR-01), busy or quiet is derived from capacity (BR-02, BR-03), never stored
displayed_result: Table of every hub, archived ones too: code, name, 'Load / capacity', Now (Quiet, Busy, Normal or Archived), base fee, open orders; 'Edit' and 'Menu' on active rows and 'archived <time>' on archived rows; the 'New hub' button; no row is written

inputs_validation: hub id in the URL; an unknown id gives 'Hub not found.' (404); archived hubs can be opened but not saved; read only
displayed_result: Form filled with the saved code, name, address, latitude, longitude, capacity and base fee; 'Load now 1 of 12 · 2 open order(s)'; the 'Archive this hub' button only when there are no open orders, otherwise the sentence 'This hub can be archived once its 2 open order(s) are finished.' (BR-18)

control: 'New hub' button (GET /admin/hubs/new) and 'Save hub' button of the empty form (POST /admin/hubs/new)
inputs_validation: code HUB- plus 2 to 8 letters or digits, name up to 80, address up to 200, latitude 10.3 to 11.2, longitude 106.3 to 107.1, capacity 1 to 500, base fee 0 to 100,000; code and name must be new (archived hubs keep theirs); every refusal keeps the typed values and writes nothing (BR-18 bounds the capacity)
displayed_result: Valid: redirect to the hub list with 'The hub is created. Add dishes to its menu before it can take orders.'; refused (400): the same form with a red box, for example 'The kitchen capacity must be between 1 and 500.' and the typed values

control: 'Save hub' button of the edit form (POST /admin/hubs/<id>)
inputs_validation: same field rules as a new hub; the code and name may stay but not clash with another hub; an archived hub cannot be changed ('is archived and can no longer be changed'); capacity may go below the current load, the hub then refuses new orders until the load falls (BR-18, BR-02)
displayed_result: Redirect to the hub list with 'The hub is saved.' and the new 'Load / capacity' in the row (for example 1 / 10); a refusal shows the red box above the form with the typed values (400)

control: 'Archive' button of an active hub that has no open orders (confirm dialog, POST /admin/hubs/<id>/archive)
inputs_validation: hub must exist, not be archived already and have no open order (any state other than delivered, failed, rejected or cancelled) (BR-18); a refusal says how many orders are open and archives nothing
displayed_result: Redirect to the hub list with 'The hub is archived. It no longer takes orders; its history is kept.'; the row is muted with the Archived badge and 'archived <time>', no Edit or Menu; a refusal shows a red 'still has N open order(s)' message
